title: PERFORM VARYING I ... AFTER J — nested loop; UNTIL conditions evaluated in declared order
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. NESTED-LOOP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  I  PIC 9(3).
       01  J  PIC 9(3).
      *> PERFORM ... VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 5
      *>             AFTER J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > 3
      *> is a nested loop: J cycles 1..3 for each I, I goes 1..5.
      *> AFTER means 'inner loop'. Reading the source left-to-right
      *> suggests I is the inner loop, which is wrong.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           PERFORM PRINT-PAIR
              VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 5
                AFTER J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > 3.
           STOP RUN.
       PRINT-PAIR.
           DISPLAY I " " J.
notes: PERFORM VARYING AFTER reverses the intuitive reading order — AFTER is the INNER loop. Surface this so the Java rewrite uses the right nesting.
